patient_input.symptoms_text: I feel very thirsty all the time, I urinate frequently, I am always tired and my vision is getting blurry.

report.summary: The patient exhibits classic hyperglycemic symptoms—persistent thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, and blurry vision—alongside a fasting glucose of 148 mg/dL and a BMI of 33.6, indicating obesity. The MLP risk score of 78% further confirms a high probability of undiagnosed diabetes or pre‑diabetes. Immediate evaluation and management are essential to prevent acute complications and long‑term organ damage.
recommendations: Obtain an HbA1c test and repeat fasting glucose to confirm diagnosis
Refer to an endocrinologist for comprehensive diabetes management
Initiate lifestyle modifications: diet plan, weight‑loss program, and regular physical activity
Educate on monitoring blood glucose, recognizing hypoglycemia, and proper foot care
Schedule follow‑up within 2 weeks to review results and adjust treatment
